mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >55% of months with FEDFUNDS decline >0.1pp, or Rank IC <0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 0.5% in the prior month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >45% of months with FEDFUNDS >0.5%, or Rank IC <0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >55% of months with UNRATE fall >0.1pp and PAYEMS rise >50k, or joint Rank IC <0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high housing starts, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches peak capacity and inflationary pressures build, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >55% of months during late-cycle expansion (HOUST >600k), or Rank IC <0.05 for HOUST in late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate consistently signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >55% of months with UNRATE rise >0.1pp, or Rank IC <0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 600,000 units in the prior month, it indicates a weakening housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >45% of months with HOUST <600.0, or Rank IC <0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in unemployment rate signals a weakening economy with both supply constraints and labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >55% of months with INDPRO fall >1.0 and UNRATE rise >0.1pp, or joint Rank IC <0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0 in the prior month, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >45% of months with INDPRO <90.0, or Rank IC <0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
